notes: Event date: sources covering 1939-09-01, cited below. English Wikipedia, Slovak invasion of Poland (R2283, tertiary): the 3rd Infantry Division Rázus is in the sector east of the High Tatras on 1 September, also described as 170 km of border between Stará Ľubovňa and the Hungarian border. The pin is Stará Ľubovňa, the named western end of that sector, a representative point (confidence 0.3, precision 80 km). Korkuć (R2281) dates the whole division crossing the Polish border only on 8 September, toward Jasło, Krosno and Sanok; that later crossing is noted and is not entered as a capture of those towns. Event definition: A dated headquarters, capture or sector location for Field Army Bernolák or one of its divisions in September 1939.
